audit.why: EVEN 5.5/10 is consistent with 53.56% over 267 games: Brand's pre-6 poke beats a slow Flash Frost, and Glacial Storm plus Rebirth take the lane back from 6.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every full-layer chart row read 'Skill' while the content layer and packet both read Brand for rows 0-3 and Anivia for rows 4-6 — seven cross-layer disagreements, and the full whys for rows 4-6 described Brand winning.
audit.why: The content layer and packet agree with the kit: Flash Frost is 11s at rank 1 and slow enough to sidestep, so Brand's 900/1050 poke owns 1-5. Glacial Storm at 6 is a sustained zone and Rebirth resets an otherwise lethal all-in, so 6 onward is hers.
audit.corrected: Full rows 0-3 -> Brand, rows 4-6 -> Anivia, with the three late whys rewritten to match. Content win[0..6] already carries these values, so no paired win[N] edit is needed; proposed as one atomic chart group.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns held no digit (lint), and the decisive interactions were never stated: Frostbite doubling off Flash Frost, Crystallize's flat 17s wall, and Rebirth surviving a full Brand rotation.
audit.why: Frostbite is a 4s cooldown at every rank and doubles its damage on a target recently hit by Flash Frost or a formed Glacial Storm — dodging the Q, not the E, is what defuses the combo. Crystallize is a flat 17s at every rank, so its downtime is a fixed window to take her side of the wave. Rebirth means a full E-Q-W-R commit ends on an egg rather than a kill.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns and the Frostbite-doubling condition written into breakdown.cooldowns; Rebirth into dontsFull[2].d and breakdown.carry; Crystallize's wall into breakdown.mid and breakdown.late.

audit.whatIsWrong: 16 lint findings: 13 misgendered fields calling Anivia he/his, two copy-paste bleeds (dosFull[1].d = tradeGood, dontsFull[2].d = tradeBad), the digit-free cooldowns field.
audit.corrected: All fixed below. The packet's two suspectNames ('Use Crystallize', 'Flash Frost's') are FALSE POSITIVES — both match the kit exactly and were left alone.
